note: Set A captures the #10 G bonding jumper spec and the NEMA 3R junction box with its location condition, and its module/terminal claims are mostly consistent with the polarity marks in the diagram. Set A's clear error is reading the outgoing connection as "INVERTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)" when the sheet says "TO PLANTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)", plus a vague SA2-26 connection target and a paraphrased "PV ARRAY RAILS" quote. Set B misbinds the note "CABLE TIES ARE U.V. RATED" to current-carrying cable, offers a nonsensical "SA1-8 connection 3", and repeats the same per-module "3" under conflicting attributes (value/component value/quantity/identifier) for SA2-21 and SA2-27. Both sets miss the SUNPREME GX290 frameless module designation and the USE-2, 10 G.A cable note, but A is the more faithful set overall.
